name: kotodama
description: Kotodama smart contracts for the Iroha Virtual Machine: highlighting, diagnostics, completion, navigation, outline, tests and formatting through the Musubi and koto toolchain

kotodama.kotoPath.description: Path to the koto executable for standalone files and tests.

kotodama.musubiPath.description: Path to the Musubi executable for project diagnostics and tests.

kotodama.manifestPath.description: Musubi.toml path, relative to the workspace folder. Empty discovers its nearest ancestor manifest. Supports ${workspaceFolder}.

kotodama.contract.description: Contract target used for navigation when a file belongs to several graphs; use a unique target name or namespace/package::target. Empty reports diagnostics for all targets.

kotodama.chainDiscriminant.description: Account-address chain discriminant for standalone koto sources. Musubi projects resolve their network context from project configuration.

kotodama.zk.description: Enable the explicit ZK compilation capability for this project's diagnostics.

semanticTokenTypes.description: A branded Kotodama keyword in either spelling: seiyaku/誓約, kotoage/言挙げ, hajimari/始まり or kaizen/改善.

test.description: Exact name of the Kotodama `#[test]` function to run.
